description: Every open position with its stake and instrument_id, plus spendable balance and net worth. Start a session here. live=true (default) adds each position's live bid (current_bid_cents, what a market sell pays now) and its midpoint mark (mark_cents). unrealized_pnl_dollars is marked at the midpoint, so selling now realises about half the spread less: contracts x current_bid_cents / 100 is the sale value. sellable=false means no market exit right now. Pass live=false for a cheap read that skips the quote fan-out.
name: get_positions
title: Open positions
